name: JTIASA
recent: Jaya Tiasa 在2026年11月20日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，录得净利 RM72.78mil，主要受 CPO 与 PK 价格走高带动。公司于10月29日发布2026年报并通知第66届常年股东大会将于11月27日举行。此外，公司近期持续进行股份回购，并披露与 Borneo Edible Oils 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估逾10%。
notable: 截至2026年9月30日季度录得净利 RM72.78mil，受 CPO 与 PK 价格走高带动。
第66届常年股东大会定于2026年11月27日举行，将寻求续聘核数师、更新关联交易授权及回购股份授权等。
与 Borneo Edible Oils 的经常性关联交易实际金额 RM799.85mil，超出预估 RM650mil 约23%。
risks: 与 Borneo Edible Oils 的关联交易实际金额超出预估逾10%，需关注后续是否需寻求股东新授权。
公司近期持续进行股份回购，可能影响股本结构与每股指标。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日财年，营收 RM286.32mil，净亏损 RM10.94mil，净利率 -3.8%；营收环比增长23.3%，同比增长8.8%，净利率较上期的 -1.6% 进一步下滑。

recent_en: Jaya Tiasa reported a net profit of RM72.78mil for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, driven by higher CPO and PK prices. The company issued its 2026 annual report on 29 October and gave notice that its 66th AGM will be held on 27 November. It also continued share buybacks and disclosed that actual recurrent related party transactions with Borneo Edible Oils exceeded the estimated value by more than 10%.
notable_en: Recorded a net profit of RM72.78mil for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, driven by higher CPO and PK prices.
The 66th AGM is scheduled for 27 November 2026, seeking reappointment of auditors, renewal of related party transaction mandate and share buyback authority.
Actual recurrent related party transactions with Borneo Edible Oils amounted to RM799.85mil, about 23% above the estimated RM650mil.
risks_en: Actual related party transaction value with Borneo Edible Oils exceeded the estimate by more than 10%, warranting attention on whether fresh shareholder mandate is needed.
The company has been continuously buying back shares, which may affect share capital structure and per-share metrics.
earnings_en: For the financial year ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM286.32mil with a net loss of RM10.94mil and net margin of -3.8%; revenue grew 23.3% QoQ and 8.8% YoY, while net margin deteriorated from -1.6% in the prior period.
